feature: The repository is a conformant Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package whose discovered skills meet Agent Skills
scope: source-contract; AI host runtime is not invoked

checks.file: plugin: plugin.json is a valid Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest
plugin: manifest version matches SKILL.md metadata.version and references/commands.md
plugin: the entry skill's metadata.version and the guard's GUARD_VERSION equal the manifest version
plugin: skills/ discovery (§7.1) finds exactly the eight command adapters and git-orchestrator
plugin: every discovered skill meets Agent Skills (strict YAML, allowed fields, name = directory, string-only metadata)
plugin: root SKILL.md (not a plugin skill) meets the same Agent Skills rules

plugin: the eight command adapters set user-invocable: false and disable-model-invocation: true, the entry skill sets user-invocable: false only (Claude Code lists the eight commands/ entries alone), and the root SKILL.md sets neither
plugin: package paths stay inside the plugin root and include no links (§4.1)
plugin: mcp.json is absent or valid (§7.2)
